# BeanBox: Specialty Coffee Subscription
## 400 Subscribers in 6 Months | 7,200 EUR MRR

---

## The Opportunity
- Kyiv’s specialty coffee market is growing and resilient [f16]
- Consumers accept premium pricing for high-quality coffee [f15]
- Direct-to-consumer subscription models are validated [f17]
- BeanBox has achieved strong initial product-market fit
- Open question: What is the Total Addressable Market (TAM)?

---

## Our Traction
- 400 paying subscribers achieved in 6 months [f2]
- Rapid growth rate: ~67 new subscribers per month [f5]
- Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) ≈ 7,200 EUR [f4]
- Calculation: 400 subscribers × 18 EUR/month [f3]
- Assumption: Current growth trajectory is sustainable

---

## The Team
- Two founders with complementary expertise
- Founder 1: Specialist Roaster (Product & Operations)
- Founder 2: Growth Marketer (Acquisition & Scaling)
- Combined skills drive both quality and customer growth [f6]
- Assumption: Specific past track records are not disclosed

---

## Competitive Landscape
- Active market with established players [f13]
- Key competitors: Kyiv City Roast, Idealist Coffee [f9]
- Competitors: Kolo Coffee, Hipsters Coffee Roastery [f12]
- Differentiation: Focused DTC subscription model
- Assumption: Specific competitive advantages are not quantified

---

## Market Context
- Specialty coffee normalized and popular since 2019 [f18]
- Premium drinks retail 80–200 UAH in Kyiv restaurants [f15]
- Competitors use unique flavors to differentiate [f10]
- Mature customer base accustomed to home delivery [f19]
- Assumption: Market size estimates are based on active roasters

---

## Financial Snapshot
- MRR: 7,200 EUR (400 subs × 18 EUR) [f4]
- Gross Margin: Not yet disclosed
- Churn Rate: Not yet disclosed
- Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC): Not yet disclosed
- Lifetime Value (LTV): Not yet disclosed

---

## The Ask: 300k EUR Seed Round
- Goal: Raise 300k EUR for seed funding [f7]
- Use of Funds: Open a second roastery [f8]
- Purpose: Solve production bottleneck to scale growth
- Equity Offer: Not yet specified
- Liabilities: No existing debts or liabilities disclosed

---

## Why This Works Now
- Proven demand: 400 subscribers in 6 months [f5]
- Clear bottleneck: Current capacity limits growth
- Solution: Second roastery enables scaling to 1,000+ subs
- Market timing: Growing specialty coffee culture in Kyiv [f18]
- Assumption: Specific operational milestones are not defined

---

## Open Questions
- What is the churn rate?
- What is the Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)?
- What is the Lifetime Value (LTV)?
- What is the current burn rate?
- What is the Total Addressable Market (TAM)?
